data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. While CloudDesk currently supports MFA via authenticator apps and email verification, we completely understand the importance of hardware tokens for enhanced security compliance. You can add your vote and specify your preferred hardware token types by visiting our feedback portal at roadmap.cloudesk.com/security-enhancements/hardware-mfa. We continually evaluate and prioritize security features based on customer demand and industry standards. [T-5833] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
